acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: IAA was added to a final concentration of 50 mM, and the reaction was carried out in the dark for 30 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: IAA was added to a final concentration of 50 mM, and the reaction was carried out in the dark for 30 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: An appropriate quantity of protein sample was digested with trypsin using Filter aided proteome preparation (FASP) method to obtain enzymatically hydrolyzed peptides.
Trypsin was added at a protein: Trypsin mass ratio of 50:1, and enzymatic digestion was performed at 37 °C overnight (15-18 h).

collision_energy.evidence: The resolution of the MS2 was 17,500 at 200 m/z, and the normalized collision energy was set to 30 eV.

enrichment_method.evidence: For the affinity enrichment of ubiquitinated peptides, 1.5 mg lyophilized peptides dissolved in pre-cooled immunoaffinity purification (IAP) buffer were co-incubated with preconditioned Anti-K-ε-GG antibody-bead complexes (PTMScan Ubiquitin Remnant Motif (K-ε-GG) Kit, Cell Signaling Technology) for 1.5 h at 4 °C.

For the affinity enrichment of ubiquitinated peptides, 1.5 mg lyophilized peptides dissolved in pre-cooled immunoaffinity purification (IAP) buffer were co-incubated with preconditioned Anti-K-ε-GG antibody-bead complexes (PTMScan Ubiquitin Remnant Motif (K-ε-GG) Kit, Cell Signaling Technology) for 1.5 h at 4 °C.

fractionation_method.evidence: The lyophilized sample (100 μg) was reconstituted in 300 μL of 0.1% TFA and fractionated using high-pH reverse-phase chromatography.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The MS2 activation type was high-energy collisional dissociation, with an isolation window of 2 m/z.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The separation was performed for all samples using the HPLC liquid phase system Easy nLC with nanoliter flow rate, with identical mobile phase constituents for both proteomic and ubiquitomic analyses: Buffer A consisted of a 0.1% formic acid-water solution, while Buffer B was a 0.1% formic acid-acetonitrile solution (84% acetonitrile).

labeling.evidence: inferred: The proteins were detected by Label Free Quantitative proteomics technology (Shanghai Applied Protein Technology).

reduction_concentration.evidence: For all samples, DTT was added to a final concentration of 10 mM, and the samples were placed in a constant-temperature mixer (600 rpm, 37 °C) for 1.5 h, then taken out and cooled to room temperature.

reduction_reagent.evidence: For all samples, DTT was added to a final concentration of 10 mM, and the samples were placed in a constant-temperature mixer (600 rpm, 37 °C) for 1.5 h, then taken out and cooled to room temperature.
